Evening routine

A gentle four-step reset.

Use this as a calm checklist. It is a demo flow and not medical advice.

  1. 01
    Dim your environmentReduce brightness and noise for five minutes.
  2. 02
    Take three slow breathsChoose a comfortable pace and stop if you feel unwell.
  3. 03
    Park tomorrow’s thoughtsWrite one note so you can return to it later.
  4. 04
    Pick a consistent lights-out timeSmall, repeatable choices are the goal.
